name: CryoEM Without Borders
description: Provisions a multi-GPU FABRIC VM (input: cryoem-without-borders storage volume; MotionCor3, CTFFIND4, RELION 5) plus a receiver VM at FIU, a stand-in for CAPE, on a dedicated L2 link (shared or ConnectX NIC). The notebook pre-processes the data and transfers the results to FIU. The slice is kept by default.
description_long: Bring-up weave for the single-particle cryoEM pre-processing demo. It picks a host with NUM_GPUS free GPUs of one model (A40 > A30 > RTX6000 > T4, from live per-host availability), creates one VM, attaches the CryoEM Without Borders CephFS project volume (the Globus collection, mounted under /mnt/cephfs/west/…_cryoem-without-borders), installs the NVIDIA driver + CUDA, builds MotionCor3 and RELION 5.0, installs CTFFIND 4.1.14 and a Python preview environment, adds a CPU receiver VM at RECEIVER_SITE (FIU; to be replaced by CAPE) connected by a dedicated site-to-site L2 link (XFER, private subnet, TCP-tuned, jumbo frames when the path allows) with SSH trust from the GPU node, extends the lease, writes results/slice_info.json and exits. It waits once for the slice to reach StableOK and does not poll after that. The experiment (frame alignment with MotionCor3 on all GPUs, CTF estimation with CTFFIND4, before/after comparison figures, iperf3 baseline + rsync transfer of the results to the receiver's local disk with checksum verification, optional RELION pipeline) lives in cryoem_experiment.ipynb. With KEEP_SLICE=true (default) neither Stop nor the cleanup script deletes the slice.

args.name: SLICE_NAME
args.label: Slice Name
args.description: FABRIC slice name (the notebook connects to this)

args.name: NUM_GPUS
args.label: GPUs on the node
args.description: GPUs attached to the VM (all from one host). MotionCor3 spreads movies across them.

args.name: GPU_MODEL
args.label: GPU Model
args.description: auto = best model with NUM_GPUS free on one host; or GPU_A40 | GPU_A30 | GPU_RTX6000 | GPU_TeslaT4

args.name: SITE
args.label: Site
args.description: Pin to a FABRIC site (blank = discover from GPU availability)

args.name: EXCLUDE_SITES
args.label: Exclude Sites
args.description: Comma-separated sites to skip during discovery

args.name: DISK
args.label: Disk (GB)
args.description: Local scratch disk (outputs go to ~/cryoem-work). Max 1000 GB; the whole-dataset run (§7b) needs ~380 GB, because each aligned sum is deleted once its CTF fit is saved.

args.name: RECEIVER_SITE
args.label: Receiver Site
args.description: Site of the downstream node that receives the processed data (FIU now; CAPE later). Blank = no receiver.

args.name: RECEIVER_CORES
args.label: Receiver Cores
args.description: Receiver VM cores (parallel rsync streams and checksum verification use them)

args.name: RECEIVER_DISK
args.label: Receiver Disk (GB)
args.description: Receiver local disk; transferred results land in ~/cryoem-inbox. Max 1000 GB; the whole-dataset results need ~380 GB.

args.name: XFER_SUBNET
args.label: Transfer Subnet
args.description: Private subnet of the dedicated L2 transfer link

args.name: XFER_NIC
args.label: Transfer NIC
args.description: NIC on both ends of the XFER link: NIC_Basic (shared) | NIC_ConnectX_5 (25G x2) | NIC_ConnectX_6 (100G x2) | NIC_ConnectX_7_100. ConnectX needs the matching project tag (e.g. Component.SmartNIC_ConnectX_5); FIU has ConnectX-5 only.

args.name: PIN_CPU
args.label: CPU pinning
args.description: true (default) = pin both VMs' vCPUs to host cores on the XFER NIC's NUMA node (CPU pinning only; no memory tuning, no restart). false = skip. On the GPU node this can move vCPUs away from the GPUs' NUMA node.

args.name: CUDA_VERSION
args.label: CUDA Toolkit
args.description: CUDA 12.x toolkit used to build MotionCor3 and RELION

args.name: INSTALL_RELION
args.label: Build RELION 5.0
args.description: Also build RELION 5.0 (CUDA, no GUI). Adds ~20 min. MotionCor3/CTFFIND work without it.

args.name: LEASE_DAYS
args.label: Lease (days)
args.description: Lease is extended to this many days from now after bring-up

args.name: KEEP_SLICE
args.label: Keep Slice
args.description: true = Stop / cleanup never delete the slice. false = cleanup deletes it.
